11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246393|a5383807.name: Jorin Croge
246393|a5383807.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed, that doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

256388|6df3de7b.name: Jornah
256388|6df3de7b.text:
Yes! Well. Sort of.

Gold is the true universal currency, but we have our own system for trade amongst ourselves known as Merchant's Favor. It abstracts away the ever-fluctuating value of gold and silver, and ensures fair and equitable trade between members of the organization. It cannot be liquidated to gold, unless you're engaging in some shady activity, I suppose.

We still use gold for typical day-to-day needs such as materials needed for common crafts, but otherwise rely on Merchant's Favor for any kind of internal commerce.

If you assist us with recovering waylaid crates and ensuring swift fulfillment of craftsman's writs, you will earn plenty!

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

3296|d2a519bc.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|d2a519bc.text: One of those Light-loving Forsaken has posted up in Grommash Hold near the other ambassadors. Perhaps he can help you.

4596|60f0c131.name: James Van Brunt
4596|60f0c131.text: You waste my time, go talk with my student Basil.

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

5624|f161af66.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f161af66.text: Paladins in War Quarter on outer ring. You find them at main building.

5819|9831b834.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|9831b834.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces made and repaired here locally, though some is scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

3096-progress.name: David Trias
3096-progress.text: So you've made it? Good, we'll have need of more rogues as time goes on. The Shadowstalkers will probably wind up finding you when they think the time's right, so don't go and slip up or do anything you might regret. They need talented agents... not pickpockets and fools.
3096-progress.title: Encrypted Scroll

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

429-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-complete.text:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment.
429-complete.title: Wild Hearts

430-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
430-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

<A few moments pass in suspenseful silence.>
430-complete.title: Return to Quinn

438-complete.name: Corpse Laden Boat
438-complete.text:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
438-complete.title: The Decrepit Ferry

439-accept.name: Corpse Laden Boat
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-complete.text:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
439-complete.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-progress.text: $N.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
439-progress.title: Rot Hide Clues

440-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
440-accept.text:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's $r he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
440-accept.title: The Engraved Ring

440-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-complete.text:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago.  She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed.  I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
440-complete.title: The Engraved Ring

440-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-progress.text: Hello, $N.  What brings you back to Brill?
440-progress.title: The Engraved Ring

441-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
441-accept.text:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
441-accept.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

441-complete.name: Raleigh Andrean
441-complete.text:
Yes, this ring was my wife's.  Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times.  I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me.  But desire does still burn in my dead heart, $N.

Desire for revenge.
441-complete.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

443-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
443-progress.text: Do you have the rot hide ichor, $N?
443-progress.title: Rot Hide Ichor

444-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-progress.text: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
444-progress.title: Rot Hide Origins

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

446-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-progress.text: Greetings, $N.  What did Bethor have to say?
446-progress.title: Thule Ravenclaw

447-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
447-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

460-accept.name: Shallow Grave
460-accept.text:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
460-accept.title: Resting in Pieces

479-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-complete.text:
Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.

A wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.
479-complete.title: Ambermill Investigations

479-progress.name: Shadow Priest Allister
479-progress.text: We must hurry, their plans must not come to fruition, or we may lose our hold on Silverpine Forest.
479-progress.title: Ambermill Investigations

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

530-accept.name: Raleigh Andrean
530-accept.text:
Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer.  Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge.  If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.

I last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
530-accept.title: A Husband's Revenge

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

6324-progress.name: Deathguard Podrig
6324-progress.text: $N, you return.  Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
6324-progress.title: Return to Podrig

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79095-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79095-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79095-complete.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

91316-complete.name: Jorin Croge
91316-complete.text: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
91316-complete.title: Making Repairs

91316-progress.name: Jorin Croge
91316-progress.text: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
91316-progress.title: Making Repairs

914-progress.name: Nara Wildmane
914-progress.text: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914-progress.title: Leaders of the Fang

91899-complete.name: Dokimi
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Dokimi
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-progress.name: Dokimi
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91920-accept.name: Quinn Yorick
91920-accept.text:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920-accept.title: Wild Eyes

91920-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
91920-complete.text:
The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.
91920-complete.title: Wild Eyes

91921-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
91921-accept.text:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921-accept.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91921-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, $N.
91921-complete.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

92422-accept.name: Deathguard Kristof
92422-accept.text:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $N.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422-accept.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

94427-accept.name: Danitha Morr
94427-accept.text:
A key tenant of being a $c is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94427-complete.name: Tanis Alderwood
94427-complete.text: You... you are a $c? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!
94427-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434-accept.name: Tanis Alderwood
94434-accept.text:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a $c want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434-complete.name: Tanis Alderwood
94434-complete.text: This is very kind of you, $c. Very kind indeed.
94434-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434-progress.name: Tanis Alderwood
94434-progress.text: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly $c.
94434-progress.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435-accept.name: Tanis Alderwood
94435-accept.text: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $c.
94435-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435-complete.name: Danitha Morr
94435-complete.text:
You have done well, $N. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light.

The Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again.

Take this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.
94435-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436-accept.name: Danitha Morr
94436-accept.text:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true $c can do.
94436-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436-complete.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94436-complete.text:
So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... well, resorting to asking paladins for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance.

Please, help me.
94436-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94438-accept.text:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-complete.name: Deathguard Falgan
94438-complete.text:
I'm... back? And saved by a $c no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.

If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more than you can do to help the Forsaken.
94438-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-accept.name: Deathguard Falgan
94440-accept.text:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive $c. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-complete.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94440-complete.text:
Thank you for saving my friend,$N. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.

I know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but its clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.
94440-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94441-accept.text:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a $c, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $N.
94441-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-complete.name: Danitha Morr
94441-complete.text:
The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a $c who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.

You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Tyr's Watch. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, $N.
94441-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

95204-complete.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-progress.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?
95204-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95314-complete.name: Carolai Anise
95314-complete.text:
You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...

...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.
95314-complete.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95803-complete.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
95803-complete.text:
I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.

There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

We will be watching.
95803-complete.title: A Token of Good Faith

95981-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-accept.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981-accept.title: Watching the Roads

96896-accept.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96896-accept.text:
Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the light as a $c. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...
96896-accept.title: A Righteous Cause

96896-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96896-complete.text: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.
96896-complete.title: A Righteous Cause

96899-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96899-complete.text:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.
96899-complete.title: Bandarion Keep

97003-accept.name: Gur'ak
97003-accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-complete.name: Gur'ak
97003-complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
97003-complete.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-complete.name: Kor'geld
97242-complete.text:
This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.

I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242-complete.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97246-complete.name: Borstan
97246-complete.text:
Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.

Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
97246-complete.title: Meal Appeal

97249-complete.name: Migi
97249-complete.text:
Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?

Oh!

Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.

Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.

If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249-complete.title: Favorite Food

97249-progress.name: Migi
97249-progress.text: I think we can win this one...
97249-progress.title: Favorite Food

97275-accept.name: Yelmak
97275-accept.text:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275-accept.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-complete.name: Whuut
97275-complete.text:
Grorru--whaa?

You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.

Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.

$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275-complete.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-progress.name: Whuut
97275-progress.text: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275-progress.title: Whuut's the Rush

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97891-complete.name: Doctor Martin Felben
97891-complete.text:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.
97891-complete.title: Prompt Potion Runner

98248-accept.name: Unknown
98248-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248-accept.title: Shipping Label

98248-complete.name: Dokimi
98248-complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find out during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248-complete.title: Shipping Label

98248-progress.name: Dokimi
98248-progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248-progress.title: Shipping Label

98298-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-accept.text:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
98298-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

98298-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-complete.text:
It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.

These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.

Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.
98298-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

98298-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-progress.text: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

98299-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-accept.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine. Be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken such as ourselves, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal.
98299-accept.title: Stop the Spread

98299-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-complete.text:
It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.

Can you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?
98299-complete.title: Stop the Spread

98545-accept.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
98545-accept.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545-accept.title: Leonid's Letter

98545-complete.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-complete.text:
Thanks for delivering this, pal.

Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that! 

Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
98545-complete.title: Leonid's Letter

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

99-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-progress.text: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, $N?
99-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

99142-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-complete.text:
Most glorious indeed!

<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>

Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!

A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
99142-complete.title: Tomb Weed

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99156-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-accept.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99156-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-complete.text:
You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.
99156-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol
